title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Provision of Emergency Child Protection and WASH services for South Sudanese and Sudan crisis affected refugees in Nyumanzi Reception Centre project provided critical child protection services and improved water and sanitation conditions for newly arrived Sudanese and South Sudanese refugees in Nyumanzi Reception Centre, with a focus on children, unaccompanied and separated children and vulnerable populations. The project provided case management support, access to psychosocial services and protection services to children, as well as enhanced water and sanitation services in the centre. The project also conducted awareness sessions on good hygiene practices and waste management to support improved hygiene and wellbeing in the RC.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved protection services and empowerment opportunities for the most vulnerable women and girls. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The Provision of Emergency Child Protection and WASH services for South Sudanese and Sudan crisis affected refugees in Nyumanzi Reception Centre project supported the acute, immediate protection and hygiene and sanitation needs of crisis affected refugees in Nyumanzi Reception Centre in Uganda. The project provided case management support to almost 700 children, organised awareness raising sessions on children's rights and refugbished the RC Child Friendly Space so children had a safe space to play in. The project also improved access to high quality WASH services through the construction of accommodation shelters and the restoration of 15 latrines, enhancing the wellbeing of the community.
